profile.name: Avery Demo
profile.desired_tone: Measured, specific and plain. Normal sentence case.
writing_samples: Name the next owner before you hand over the request. Otherwise the work has moved but the waiting has not.
restrictions: Fictional evaluation creator. No invented results, personal experiences or identifiable clients.

cases.voice:
# Voice

Fictional evaluation profile; these preferences are confirmed for this fixture.
Use normal sentence case and practical, measured prose. Prefer concrete process
verbs. No hype, slang persona, hashtags or automatic CTA. The supplied sample
uses a concrete action followed by its consequence. Do not copy its cadence
into every piece. No measured business results have been supplied.
cases.source:
Avery: The handoff log has columns Request, Next owner, Next action and Check again at.
Avery: A blank Next owner means nobody has accepted the request yet.
Avery: For a teaching demo I can show a fictional row, name the next owner and fill in the next action and check time.
Avery: We have not measured whether this changed delivery times or sales.
Avery: Someone asked what happens when the named owner is absent. I do not have an example or a process for that yet.
cases.parent_body: A handoff needs one named owner for the next step.
cases.brief: Develop this measured winner into worthwhile follow-up opportunities. Choose what the source supports now and preserve any useful unanswered questions. Do not fill a quota. All creator details, posts and analytics here are fictional fixtures.

rubric.question: Do the opportunities add concrete utility beyond naming an owner, use native formats supported by the actual log/demo, and keep the absent-owner case or outcome claims blocked behind missing evidence rather than inventing them? Is the performance explanation tentative rather than causal?
